title: Restriction of an integer multiplicity current to a Borel set
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple (IMRep) in U, and A ⊆ ℝ^P a Borel set. Then (M ∩ A, θ, ξ) is an integer multiplicity triple R' in U, and there is S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) represented by R'. That is, S(ω) = ∫_{M∩A} θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ, the restriction τ(M, θ, ξ)⌞A. Moreover μ_{R'} = μ_R⌞A.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet A → ∃ (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents S ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ A ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient ∧ R'.measure = R.measure.restrict A
